You will be the connecting link between global HR strategy and local business realities. Your mission is to ensure that global HR policies, processes and initiatives are successfully implemented across the region, while considering local cultures, business needs and employment legislation. You will operate in a diverse international environment, supporting both smaller country organizations and larger entities. This requires a balance between strategic leadership and operational involvement. You are not someone who manages HR exclusively from behind a desk: you enjoy being close to the business, listening to people and turning challenges into practical solutions. Promote a strong organizational culture where employees feel engaged, motivated and empowered to perform. Identify current and future talent needs and develop initiatives to strengthen organizational capabilities. 4. People Leadership & International Collaboration Lead and support an international HR team, working closely with local HR representatives in countries including the UK, India, France and Poland. Build strong relationships with local stakeholders and establish trust across different cultures and organisational levels. Work closely with commercial and financial leadership teams. Provide structure, clarity and direction while maintaining flexibility to respond to local business needs. Your profile We are looking for an experienced HR professional with a strong international mindset, a confident personality and a pragmatic approach. You are comfortable operating in an environment where different cultures, interests and management styles come together. You know when to connect, when to influence and when to take a clear position. Proven experience supporting and managing HR activities across multiple countries. Strong knowledge of various HR disciplines, including talent management, organizational development, change management and HR processes. Experience in implementing international HR strategies and creating buy-in among local management teams. Familiarity with different employment law frameworks and social legislation. Experience with SAP SuccessFactors or similar HR systems is an advantage. Fluency in English and 1 other language. Additional languages are a plus. A willingness to travel internationally, approximately 40–50% of your time. Your personality makes the difference Beyond your professional experience, your personality and maturity will be key to your success. Strong yet approachable: You have the backbone to address difficult situations and stand by your decisions, while maintaining constructive relationships. Culturally aware: You understand that there is no one-size-fits-all approach to HR and can adapt your style to different cultures and expectations. Hands-on and pragmatic: You think strategically but never lose sight of operational realities. Diplomatic yet assertive: You can navigate complex stakeholder dynamics and confidently balance local business interests with global HR priorities. Accessible and authentic: People feel comfortable approaching you. You listen, ask the right questions and are not afraid to provide directions. Solution-oriented and decisive: You take ownership, think creatively and turn challenges into workable solutions. Grounded and humble: You value collaboration and results over titles and hierarchy. Ready to make an international impact?
